question: Does the personal Free held-recordings card ("6 h 20 min of your recordings are safe but unprocessed. Upgrade to process now.") raise Upgrade taps over the stable 10% holdout that still sees the previous card, per namespace and build? Compare Held Audio Upgrade Tapped per Held Audio Card Seen with variant=personal against variant=holdout. variant=paid rows are paid owners, who see the process action instead (Held Audio Process Tapped). The holdout changes copy only, never who can recover. No property identifies a person.
zero_policy: Zero events is expected when no owner in the selected namespace and build has held recordings or a waiting processing choice. Absence is not a recovery or billing failure.
